description: SP ENW - Flexibility - Postcode Data is a dataset listed in Electricity North West open data portal, an open data portal of an electricity distribution network operator, published or maintained by Electricity North West. Dataset Classification - Open SP ENW - Flexibility - Postcode Data Dataset aligning Postcodes with the name of the feeding Substation This Flexibility Tender Postcode Data can be viewed on a map together with the relevant Flexibility Tender Site Requirement Polygons HERE While we use reasonable endeavours to ensure that the data contained within this ... Coverage: Great Britain (network area of the operator or portal owner). It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal files it under Flexibility Data. Its keywords are Flexibility, Postcode, Flexible, FlexMap, Battery Storage Persona, Distributed Generator Persona. The portal shows 2026-06-12 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC BY 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support network planning and operations studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-enw-open-data-portal.
